title: Creative Approval Status
description: Aggregate approval state of a creative on a specific package. Mixed publisher or placement eligibility uses partially_approved plus approval_scopes on the assignment.

enumDescriptions.pending_review: Creative has been submitted and is awaiting platform review
enumDescriptions.approved: Creative has been approved and is eligible for delivery across the whole package–creative assignment.
enumDescriptions.partially_approved: A multi-publisher or multi-placement assignment is eligible in at least one scope but not uniformly eligible across all scopes. Inspect approval_scopes for the complete per-scope outcomes.
enumDescriptions.rejected: Creative was rejected by the platform, including change requests; see rejection_reason for required fixes and re-upload via sync_creatives
